policy: Snapshot of currently completed errors. Probe each assigned QLP training sector independently; use surviving sectors if original combined load failed. If none survive, or rerun fails, try same assigned epochs in SPOC. Never load reserved epochs. Reduced sector searches have narrower period coverage. Original error estimates/published errors policy retained. Data-dependent recovery is not independent validation.
